blocks.text: Whalley homes listed and sold, June to October 2026

Whalley, October 2026. Detached houses: 81 listed at month end and 4 sold in October, a sales ratio of 5% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 604 listed at month end and 42 sold in October, a sales ratio of 7% (a buyers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 14 sold over 5 months against an average of 84.0 listed, about 30.0 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 4 sold. Condos and townhomes: 251 sold over 5 months against an average of 618.6 listed, about 12.3 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 65 sold.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Whalley?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 81 houses listed with 4 sold in the month and 604 condos and townhomes listed with 42 sold in the month in Whalley. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Whalley a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 5%, a buyers’ market; condos and townhomes had a sales ratio of 7%, a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
